import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for safe insertion. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}
Description:
{event_description}
{additional_notes_section} """ def create_event_invitation(e_title: str, e_description: str, e_date: str, e_notes: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- e_title : str The name or heading of the event. e_description : str An extensive description (may contain line breaks or formatting). e_date : str The scheduled date of the event. e_notes : str Any extra information or instructions supplied by the user. Returns ------- str A string containing safe, sanitized HTML ready for rendering. """ # Escape all user-controllable input to prevent XSS safe_title = html.escape(e_title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(e_description, quote=True) safe_date = html.escape(e_date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(e_notes, quote=True) # Render additional notes only if provided if safe_notes.strip(): notes_html = f'
Additional Notes:
{safe_notes}
' else: notes_html = '' # Format the final HTML invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes_section=notes_html ) return invitation_html
